senses.gloss:
mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
1 Floral, flowery, relating to flowers.
2 Agreeable, pleasing.
E.
सुमनस्, and अण् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
Enjoyment, satisfaction.
E.
सुमनस् content, ष्यञ् aff.

f. (-नी)
The blossom of the great-flowered jasmine.
E.
सुमनस् the plant, फक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Lunar, relating to SOMA or the moon.
2 Performed with the Sarcostema juice, relating to it, &c.
f. (-की)
A sacrifice performed on the day of full moon.
E.
सोम the moon, ठक् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
LAKṢMAṆA, the younger brother of RĀMA.
E.
सुभित्रा the wife of DAŚARATHA, and mother of this prince, and अण् aff.; also with इञ्, aff. सौमित्रि.

m. (-कः)
A sage, a seer, one possessing supernatural knowledge or power.
E.
सु excellent, मेधा apprehension, ठक् aff.

n. (-कं)
Gold.
E.
सुमेरु the mountain, with कन् added, and अण् aff. of origin.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या or मी-म्यं)
1 Handsome, pleasing.
2 Mild, gentle, placid.
3 Sacred or belonging to SOMA or the moon.
m. (-म्यः)
1 BUDDHA, regent of MERCURY, and son of SOMA or the moon.
2 One of the nine Khaṇḍas or divisions of the known continent.
3 A term applied to a pupil when addressing instruction to one.
4 (In anatomy,) The blood before it receives the red particles, the serum.
m. plu. (-म्याः)
Five stars in Orion's head.
f. (-म्या)
1 A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
2 Heart-pea.
3 The Abrus precatorious.
4 The moon-plant, (Sarcostema acida.)
5 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.)
6 Arabian jasmine.
E.
सोम the moon, ण्यत् or यत् aff., or द्यण् aff., when the word takes ङीप् in the feminine form.

n. (-च्छ्रं)
A religious penance, subsisting for five days, severally, on sesamum after expression, the water of boiled rice, butter-milk mixed with water, water, and parched grain, and fasting on the sixth day.
E.
सौम्य relating to the moon, and कृच्छ्र penance.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Beauty.
2 Gentleness, placidity.
E.
त्व added to सौम्य; also with तल्, सौम्यता.

m. (-तुः)
Phlegm, the phlegmatic humor.
E.
सौम्य lunar, and घातु element.
